paragraphs.text: Ravnica Allegiance Mythic Edition is a special Ravnica Allegiance draft -sized booster box . This product became available on the Hasbro 's ebay store , only on January 24 for $249.99 and could be shipped internationally for customers with a US PayPal account. Ravnica Allegiance Mythic Edition was limited to only 12,000 units.

The Mythic Edition includes 24 Ravnica Allegiance boosters. Eight of these booster are clearly marked as "Masterpiece Boosters" and contain one of eight foil Masterpieces in addition to their normal rare/mythic rare card.
Each unit contains all 8 Masterpiece cards:
The Masterpieces use the expansion symbol and code that were also used for the Guilds of Ravnica Mythic Edition .
The Masterpiece boosters also contain an appropriate token or emblem :
0/0 Construct artifact creature with "This creature gets +1/+1 for each artifact you control" for Karn, Scion of Urza , but also found with Sorin Markov
Emblem for Tamiyo, the Moon Sage
The following tokens are from Ravnica Allegiance :
4/4 Beast creature with trample , with Ajani, Mentor of Heroes and Kaya, Orzhov Usurper , but used for Domri, Chaos Bringer
